source_player_exact: #Суйтон водяной дракон в того кто на крыше, суйтон водный клон к куноичи с печатями, сам в сонбоны в копейщика остановка проводимости мышц, не смертельная#
player_actions: From current position uses Suiton Water Dragon aimed at rooftop Doton shinobi, sourced from stream/waterwheel flow
Conjures one Suiton Water Clone from available runoff, sends clone to female seals combatant near stream
Throws medically chakra-directed senbon at spear fighter to impair motor nerve conduction nonlethally
not_player_actions: Shiki does not advance, pursue, respond to enemy question, kill any opponent, heal patient or rescue personally beyond his three declared attacks. No words/feelings/intent beyond user input.

chronology.event: High-skill A-rank Suiton Water Dragon launched from water mill stream at man on roof 27m horizontal and 6m elevation. Male urgently breaks Doton concentration and raises partial earth roof barrier but poor footing on wet roof weakens it. Dragon breaks barrier and blows attacker off roof to wooden rear maintenance platform, platform partially breaks; attacker coughed, remains alive and tries to rise with LEFT arm hanging low, potentially serious shoulder injury. Doton structural destruction technique interrupted but previous damage to stone support is NOT reversed.

Ritsu acts independently, orders move of patient litter out of collapsing beam footprint; 2 medics and Ritsu shoulder-wounded pull litter approximately 1-2m aside. Stone lintel collapses behind them in dust; litter, patient, oxygen/IV lines remain intact. Patient breathing weakly on assisted oxygen; current SpO2 not reliably remeasured. They withdraw to protective stone wall, continue hospital evacuation. No Shiki direct assistance attributed.

chronology.actor: Shiki's Suiton Water Clone vs seal woman
chronology.event: One water clone forms from dragon runoff and runs toward bandaged female around18m away. Woman's body-language shifts from watching dragon impact to uncertain whether clone is real Shiki; feet reposition, throws 2 of 4 rectangular seal plates and extends taut net with chakra binding on ground. Clone collides with seal network and dispels as binding drains coherence, but forces commitment/occupation of 2 plates and some anchored wires. Female retreats a couple meters to waterwheel bridge with TWO remaining prepared plates, now ~20m from Shiki. Woman is not knocked out or controlled.

chronology.actor: Shiki vs spear fighter / Kusa guard
chronology.event: Shiki throws precise chakra-conducting SENBON while spear fighter engaged with bleeding-hand Kusa guard around12m away. 1st needle hits right forearm peripheral motor branch, disrupting wrist/hand function and control of spear (not complete arm paralysis); 2nd hits region lateral left proximal calf near fibular nerve, impaired left foot dorsiflexion/eversion and causes stumble; 3rd clips sleeve as opponent falls and misses target. Peripheral temporary neural conduction interference, no lethal body target and no claim guaranteed reversibility. Kusa guard independently tackles wounded fighter and second Kusa ally helps bind him; spear fighter captured alive, conscious and partially mobile in other muscles.

Roof Doton man now ~31m at broken rear platform, coughing with probable left shoulder trauma, attempting to rise, not yet captured or confirmed unable to fight. Seal woman at waterside bridge ~20m, 2 seals left, tense/conflicted, says 'Ты мог убить моего товарища. Но не убил. Почему?' Injured male calls 'Не разговаривай с ним! Уходи!' Woman remains guarding bridge and has not surrendered. Ritsu and medics with patient behind stone wall, not yet in village. Shiki has tactical control over front access but still unknown opposition, no further Shiki action.

current.location: Страна Травы, старая водяная мельница у восточного тракта, ~1.5 км к востоку от Ивового брода

current.seal_woman: Bandaged-face kunoichi ~20m near narrow wooden footbridge/waterwheel, two rectangular seal plates left of four originally, taut metal cable, visually wary of Shiki's power and uncanny composure, asks why he spared her comrade. Prepared to use seals, not captured.
current.doton_enemy: Roof Doton attacker thrown from 6m roof onto rear wooden platform (platform broke and partly cushioned fall), visible ~31m from Shiki, coughs, tries to rise, left upper limb low/potential injury, no verified fatality nor capture.
current.spear_enemy: Thin male spearman alive and captured by Kusa medevac escorts. Right forearm/wrist motor deficit from Shiki medical senbon and left peroneal-nerve region deficit in foot raise, can still move other muscles and breathe. Spear released, guarded, no automatic recovery.
current.patient: Adult male unknown ID in oxygen-supplied transport litter behind protective stone wall after Ritsu/medics independently moved stretcher before stone beam collapse. Serious respiratory weakness, oxygen line and unknown IV both intact and running, last reliable SpO2 92% on oxygen immediately before incident; no new fresh measurement. No definitive improvement or capture.
current.ritsu: Kazama Ritsu shallow left shoulder wound, with medics successfully moves litter and maintains care; independent operational medic, trying to evacuate, not puppeted by Shiki.
current.other: Kusa guard with bloodied left hand spared from spear thrust, Kusa shinobi at tree with thigh injury. Mill roof/building partly damaged, collapsed overhead lintel now blocks old passage. Rain, smoke, water stream. More security on way from Ivovy post under Jun but not yet arrived.
current.decision_gate: 18:14:16. Bandaged woman ~20m armed with 2 seals, injured Doton attacker ~31m trying to stand; spear enemy restrained. Patient alive, move to safe evacuation not completed. Female directly asks Shiki why he didn't kill. Player can choose combat/dialogue/escort etc. No auto action.
